nodes.name: ReadStandingOrder
nodes.role: read the user's current rent standing order

nodes.name: CheckNextMonth
nodes.role: determine the rent amount and due date for next month and compare them with the standing order

nodes.name: ConfirmChange
nodes.role: ask the user to approve any change to the rent amount or due date for next month

nodes.name: UpdateRentPayment
nodes.role: change only the amount or due date of the rent standing order that the user approved

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user whether the next month's rent payment was already correct or was updated
